data.title: Violet
data.about:
DAMAC Violet Townhouses in Dubai has launched its fourth phase. Nestled within the tranquil community of Damac Hills 2, these 4-bedroom townhouses offer an exceptional living experience. Choose from meticulously designed residences featuring a rooftop and private garden.

Residents of DAMAC Violet Townhouses can enjoy a wide range of facilities that elevate their lifestyle. Amenities include access to Malibu Beach, a wave surfing simulator, a lazy river, and various sports facilities. Additionally, the community is well-equipped with a supermarket, medical clinic, and a community center, ensuring daily needs are easily met.

location_tile.title: Discover a Dynamic Lifestyle Centered on Wellness, Adventure and Fun!
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Violet Townhouses are situated in the peaceful community of DAMAC Hills 2, offering residents excellent connectivity to the rest of Dubai. With easy access to major highways, traveling to key destinations is quick and convenient.

The community itself is divided into three vibrant towns, each offering unique experiences. Water Town features attractions like Malibu Beach, a wave pool, and splash pads, perfect for water enthusiasts. Sports Town caters to active lifestyles with tennis, basketball, and football courts, along with a paintball park. For those seeking relaxation, Down Town provides peaceful spaces such as a zen garden for yoga, green zones, outdoor play areas, and BBQ spots

  • 15 minutes to DAMAC Hills
  • 25 minutes to Global Village
  • 25 minutes to IMG Worlds of Adventure
  • 25 minutes to Dubai Outlet Mall
  • 30 minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 35 minutes to Dubai International Airport
